players.bio: Adam Michael Reach (born 3 February 1993) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left-back or left winger for EFL Championship club Lincoln City.
Andrei Coubiș (born 29 September 2003) is a professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Lincoln City. Born in Italy, he plays for the Romania national team.
Benjamin House (born 5 July 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Lincoln City. Born in England, he represented Scotland at youth international level.
Callum Roddie Elder (born 27 January 1995) is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a left back for EFL Championship club Lincoln City and the Australia national team.
Charlie Parks is a 19-year-old professional football player who currently plays as a central defender (wearing squad number 39) for Lincoln City Football Club

Chiedozie Somkelechukwu Ogbene (born 1 May 1997) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Lincoln City on loan from Premier League club Ipswich Town, and the Republic of Ireland national team. Ogbene began his career in Ireland with Cork City and Limerick, before transferring to Brentford in 2018.

Christopher David Cohen (born 5 March 1987) is an English former professional footballer and co-head coach at EFL Championship club Lincoln City with Tom Shaw. Primarily a midfielder, he was able to operate equally in the centre or on the left, but was also employed at times as a left-back.
Conor McGrandles (born 24 September 1995) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Lincoln City.
Ayodeji Joshua Oluwapelumi Akinola Elerewe (born 14 September 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Lincoln City.

Dominic William Jefferies (born 22 May 2002) is a Welsh professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Lincoln City. Jefferies is a product of the Cardiff City and Newport County academies and began his professional career with Brentford B.

Ethan Joseph Wheatley (born 20 January 2006) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Lincoln City on loan from Premier League club Manchester United. He is an England youth international.
Frederick Charles Draper (born 28 July 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Lincoln City.
George Alexander Wickens (born 8 November 2001) is an English footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Lincoln City. He is an England youth international.

Isaac Tanitoluwaloba Aduraoluwatimileyin "Tanto" Olaofe (born 21 November 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays for EFL Championship club Lincoln City on loan from EFL Championship club Charlton Athletic as a striker. Olaofe came through the youth system of Millwall, and spent time on loan with Sutton United and St Johnstone.
Ivan Varfolomeyev is a Ukrainian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Lincoln City.

James Christopher Pardington (born 20 July 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Lincoln City. He came through the youth team at Wolverhampton Wanderers, spending time on loan at Bath City, Stratford Town, Dulwich Hamlet and Mansfield Town. During the 2022–23 season he spent time with Grimsby Town and Larne.

Joe Anthony Gauci is an Australian professional soccer player who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Lincoln City, on loan from Premier League club Aston Villa. He also represents the Australia national team. Born in Australia, Gauci is of Maltese descent and lived on New Zealand's Waiheke Island between the ages of four and eleven, playing club football for Waiheke United.
Joshua Phillip Honohan (born 28 March 2001) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Lincoln City.

Mason Melia (born 22 September 2007) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Lincoln City on loan from Premier League club Tottenham Hotspur and the Republic of Ireland national team.

Reeco Lee Hackett-Fairchild (born 9 January 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Lincoln City. Born in England, he plays for the Saint Lucia national team.

Robert Nicholas Street (born 26 September 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a striker for EFL Championship club Lincoln City. Street began his career with Crystal Palace, signing his first professional contract with them in 2020. He spent time on loan at Torquay United, Newport County and Shrewsbury Town, before signing for Cheltenham Town on a free transfer in 2023.
Ryley Ben Towler (born 6 May 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre back for EFL Championship club Lincoln City.
Sonny Bradley (born 13 September 1991) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Lincoln City.

Tendayi David Darikwa (born 13 December 1991) is a professional footballer who plays as a right back for EFL Championship club Lincoln City. Born in England, he plays international football for Zimbabwe.
Thomas David Bayliss (born 6 April 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Lincoln City.
Thomas Philip Hamer (born 1 October 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right back or centre back for EFL Championship side Lincoln City.

Thomas William Shaw (born 1 December 1986) is an English former footballer and co-head coach at EFL Championship side Lincoln City with Chris Cohen. Shaw began his career at Rushden & Diamonds, making over 50 appearances in the Football League and Conference between 2006 and 2008.
Yunus Emre Konak (born 10 January 2006) is a Turkish professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Lincoln City on loan from Premier League club Brentford.
